text: About 0.6 hectares (3.41% of the 17.6-hectare property) of native forest was lost in 2022. This loss was primarily native forest (0.5 ha), with a small portion (0.1 ha) outside mapped forest areas. The change was detected by satellite imagery and corroborated by reference data, but the cause (e.g., logging, fire, or natural disturbance) and legality remain unknown. The loss was concentrated in a single event, with an additional 0.2 ha of smaller patches also affected but not counted as part of the main event.
